01 Geospatial machine learning

## GeoCam Campus Locator

A photo-based campus building identifier paired with an interactive Cal Poly explorer. The mobile app connects a React Native camera workflow to a vision pipeline built with fine-tuned OpenCLIP and SIFT-LightGlue, then returns a predicted building, confidence score, and useful campus details.

::: tag-row
PythonOpenCLIPLightGlueReact Native
:::

## Investigating Butterfly Habitats

This study uses multilevel regression to examine how temperature, humidity, seasonal variation, and other environmental conditions affect the likelihood of butterflies being present in an area.

::: tag-row
Multilevel modelsEcologyResearch
:::
